name: fluid
description: Fluid — a Smalltalk-inspector-inspired web UI: explore and shape your GraphQL data through reusable, LLM-generated dashboard views.

scripts.pack:cli: pnpm --filter @fluid/frontend build && pnpm --filter @fluid/frontend build:viewer && pnpm --filter @fluid/bff prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @fluid/cli build:pack && mkdir -p out && npm pack ./apps/cli/pkg --pack-destination ./out
